fixed.problem: Blocking 1 (W15-02 with W15-05). A commit the person pushed to GitHub, as the folder-wait sentence tells them to, was taken as reviewed. The next rebuild (dependency squash-merged) moved the record's reviewed_head_sha onto it, and the Overview offered Merge under 'Reviewed by the critic'. A Merge pressed during the commit wait, which W15-05 keeps, then made Forerunner merge mine.txt into main by itself (bench J3, J4). The same hole existed before wave 15 for any commit pushed to a dependent's branch on GitHub.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/dependent-branches-merge.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15': "the person's commit pushed to GitHub, as the sentence offers, with A squash-merged ..." (reviewed_head_sha moved, last_outcome not_allowed); "Merge pressed during the commit wait, then the commit pushed ..." (#B merged by Forerunner); "a commit pushed to B's branch on GitHub before A is squash-merged ..." (sibling)
fixed.how: Root cause: settleRecord (session/dependent-branches.ts) compared ownBefore with ownAfter. Both were read from GitHub's branch, which already held the pushed commit, and neither was compared with the record. The fix adds reviewedChangeBefore: the branch's own change before the rebuild must equal the record's own_change_id, the same rule ReviewedPrMerge.keepsOwnChange uses. With no own_change_id, the head must equal reviewed_head_sha. A rebuild whose push failed had already moved the record to its own head and change, so it still rebuilds. When the change differs, changedAfterReview runs. It leaves the record at the reviewed commit as left_to_you with head_moved and headMovedSentence ('#N changed after the review: look at the new commits, then merge it yourself or redo the task.'), so there is no Merge. It sets approval to none, which drops a kept press. One card says it: an open merge card takes the words, and a new card is filed only when the record was not already waiting for the person, as the merge step's settle does. Said once.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live: run a chain A <- B on a repository project. In B's task folder (the path under B's Overview row), commit a file. Squash-merge A on GitHub. Within one poll B's row reads '#N waits for a commit made in its task's folder: push it to GitHub or undo it.'; press Merge there (answer: the same sentence). Push the commit from the folder. Within a poll or two, B's row reads '#N changed after the review: look at the new commits, then merge it yourself or redo the task.' with no Merge, and the Tasks row reads 'Accepted · changed after the review'. One Inbox card says the same. Pressing Merge is refused with those words. Wait several polls: #N is not merged and the file is not on main. Bench fixup-w15-merge J3 and J4 passed every check (steps/j3-checks.json, j4-checks.json, screenshots 08-11).

fixed.problem: Blocking 2 (W15-01). The second project's status 'stays in the app', but its Docs tab said 'docs/status.md missing / not written yet' and GET /projects/<B>/docs/docs%2Fstatus.md answered 404. The user guide and ADR 0106's amendment promised that B keeps its status under Docs.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/loop-docs.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15' > 'the status a project keeps in the app while another project's status pull request is open is where its Docs tab reads docs/status.md, after a restart too ...'; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15' W15-01 case: B's GET /projects/:id/docs and docs/status.md before and after the daemon is composed again (failed with 'not written yet')
fixed.how: Root cause: ProjectDocs.statusDocRoot (loop/docs.ts) returned null whenever the status pull request setting was on. Now, when another project's open status PR keeps this project's status in the app, writeSessionStatus also writes a file (STATUS_HELD_MARK, '.held-by-another-status-pr') in the app-status folder. While that file exists, statusDocRoot gives the Docs routes the app's copy first, as with the setting off. Being a file, it survives a restart. It is removed when the project's next status is written to its own pull request, or kept in the app with the setting off. docs-routes.ts is in no wave-15 area, so it is unchanged (see not_done for its note words).
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live: link projects A and B to one repository, Status pull request on in both. Run a session in A (its status PR opens), then one in B. B's Docs tab lists Status docs/status.md as present, and opening it shows B's session ('Write the notes in b-notes.md'), not A's. The same holds after the app restarts. Close A's status PR on GitHub and run another session in B: B opens its own status PR, and its Docs tab reads the repository's copy again. Bench J1/J1b/J1c/J1d passed every check, after a daemon restart too (steps 01-06).

fixed.problem: Blocking 3 (W15-04). The Tasks-row Redo withdrew the done task's merge card outside the move's change, so Undo put the task back to done but left the conflict notice withdrawn for good, still carrying the redo_from_base mark. The notice is said once, so no poll brought it back. The Redo's line also did not say the card closed or that the redo starts from main, and no undo test existed.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/dependent-branches-merge.test.ts W15-04 block > "the Tasks row's Redo says the card closed and the task is done again from main; its Undo puts the task back to done and opens the same card again, without the Redo's mark ..."; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'w15-merge, wave 15' > "the Tasks row's Redo of a done task with a conflict notice ... its Undo, after the daemon starts again ..." (POST /tasks/:id/action redo, the daemon composed again, then POST /changes/:id/undo)
fixed.how: personMove (commands/task.ts) now withdraws a done task's open merge cards itself (redoMergeCards, opts.redoMergeCards from taskReopen). That puts them in after.withdrawn_requests, and after.redone_cards records what each card held in the fields the mark sets (redoMarkOf in loop/merge-mode.ts). moveSentence gains fromMain: 'Reopened "X" to redo it from main: the next session works on it again. Its card in the Inbox was withdrawn.' undoMove reopens the cards with the mark taken off (notRedoneMergeCard). taskReopen.undoSentence adds '; its card is back in the Inbox'. It still starts no session (the owner question). The fake daemon's redo withdraws a done task's merge:left_open cards and says the same line. The misplaced doc comment above openMergeCards is fixed.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live: make a done task's PR conflict with main (merge a conflicting change on GitHub) until the Inbox shows '"<task>" conflicts with main'. Press Redo on its Tasks row: the line reads 'Reopened "<task>" to redo it from main: the next session works on it again. Its card in the Inbox was withdrawn.', the card leaves the Inbox, and no session starts. Restart the app, then press Undo on that change in Changes. It reads 'Undone: the task "<task>" is done again; its card is back in the Inbox.', the task row reads 'Accepted · conflicts with main', and the same card is in Needs you with Redo and Leave it open, still there after two polls. Bench J5/J5b with a daemon restart between them passed every check (steps 12-17).

Data loss sibling of W15-02, at pr-executor.ts executeIn, the resume path without work in progress (`else await git.createBranch(branch, `origin/${branch}`)`). A Tasks-row Redo of a done task with no merge card, or any resume of a branch whose PR is open, resets the local branch to GitHub's, so a commit the person made in the task folder is dropped without a word. A fix should check folderHold(git, branch, base) === 'commits' there first, then either stop with needs_human and one sentence or bring the commit along into the run. Choosing between them needs a decision.

The chat's docs search (ProjectDocs.docsDirsFor) never reads the app-status folder, with the status PR setting off or held, so the chat cannot quote a repository project's own status that is kept in the app.

The head-moved card filed when a kept press is dropped (and by the merge step) is titled with the old first sentence 'The critic accepted "X", but pull request #3 was not merged' and offers only 'I merged it' / 'Leave it open' while its sentence says '... or redo the task' (request-words mergeLeftOpenCard, w15-words' function).

Its card in the Inbox was withdrawn.' (commands/task.ts moveSentence, new extra `fromMain`). (2) Its Undo: 'Undone: the task "X" is done again; its card is back in the Inbox.' loop/merge-mode.ts exports redoMarkOf(card) and notRedoneMergeCard(card, was). task.reopen's change has after.withdrawn_requests (including the merge cards) and after.redone_cards {id: {applied_at, outcome, redo_from_base}}.

session/dependent-branches.ts: settleRecord's clean same-own-change branch now first checks reviewedChangeBefore(record, r) (own_change_id, or reviewed_head_sha when there is none). The record goes head_moved with approval 'none' when the check fails. Anything that moves reviewed_head_sha on a rebuild should keep this check.
ProjectPullRequests.merge: a row whose merge.state is 'blocked' (branch rules) is refused with its sentence even when its record waits for the task's folder.

apps/ui/test/fake-daemon.ts: a 'redo' task action on a done task withdraws its open merge:left_open cards, records them in after.withdrawn_requests and says the 'from main' line (fake-tasks.ts actionSentence gains `fromMain`).
